programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Bayern" - "Monaco"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: UFC. Mario Bautista – Vinicius Oliveira

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Crvena Zvezda" - "Maccabi"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: UFC. Mario Bautista-Vinicius Oliveira
programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Ligue 1. PSG - Marseille
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Wala Ka Ng Puwang Sa Mundo
Eerie
programme.desc: Ms. Pat (Bea Alonzo) works as a guidance counselor in a conservative, all-girls, Catholic high school. Secretly a clairvoyant, she waits at her desk every night for midnight therapy sessions with the ghost of Eri, a student who committed suicide on the school grounds more than a decade ago. Her routine is shattered when a student is found murdered on campus. Suspecting the culprit to be the school's fanatical overseer Sor Alice (Charo Santos), Ms. Pat turns to the sole watcher of the schoolEri.

programme.desc: Ayef meets Manny. It is at a time where she focuses on her dreams while Manny being a flighty young shop owner, goes with the flow. programme.title: Walk of Art: Walk of Art: Doha's Cultural Landscape
programme.desc: We explore how art has influenced the cultural landscape of Qatar and how it can be an immersive experience for those who visit, live and work there. We meet designers and artists who reflect the country's layers of creativity, cultural diversity and modern identity. They guide us through Doha's open-air gallery, taking us to the public artwork that inspires them the most and represents a milestone in Qatar's artistic evolution. From Doha Mountains and Cesar's Pouce to remembering Qatar's pearl diving heritage and the first artistic landmark - the Museum of Islamic Art.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Poppy is having a line dancing party, but none of the other flowertots know how to do it. Will any of them learn to dance in time or will Poppy have to cancel the party?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Aunt Tulip has lost Grubby again. When Stingo finds him, he asks to be made King as a reward. It isn't long before he has gone too far and the tots are all fed up with his demands. Can Fifi get life in the garden back to normal?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: The tots are playing hide and seek and the winner will get Fifi's delicious jam tarts. Who will win, Stingo and Slugsy are sure it will be them!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble fall out in a big way after Fifi doesn't show up to the picnic they are supposed to have together. How strange that Stingo is trying to get them to be friends again, or is it?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots
programme.desc: Diggly is bored of life on his compost heap and wants to see round the rest of the garden. Fifi offers to give him a guided tour. Diggly gets lost, how will he get home?

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: After noticing all the great compliments Mother receives on account of adorable baby William, Olivia finds herself some babies of her own: her cat Edwin and her dog Perry. Being a mum is tougher than it seems, but when Mother asks Olivia to watch William for a minute, her new skills come in handy.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: When Olivia and her family go to the beach, Olivia finds what she thinks is a pearl-making oyster. She enlists Ian and Julian to help her find more, imagining that they're pirates in search of buried treasure. In reality, Father explains that they've actually found clams: no pearls inside, but great for a clambake!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!
programme.desc: The Trolls try to entertain and win over Archer Pastry with a series of Troll stories/When a rainbow over Troll Village begins to experience a catastrophic breakdown, Cloud Guy arrives in the village to offer his assistance.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On!
programme.desc: When Cooper loses Guy Diamond in Troll Forest, Poppy and Branch accompany him as he retraces his steps /Poppy sets out to recreate the recipe of Branch's favorite dessert at any cost.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh!
programme.desc: Tip tricks Oh into thinking he's invincible to convince him to go on a dangerous adventure/Sharzod takes revenge when she loses her squad to her arch-rival Fance.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh!
programme.desc: When Tip and Oh bring Fox and Pom Pom together, the baddies get badder/When Oh agrees to be Donny's wingman for a job, Donny introduces him to a shady underworld.

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: With the Trux in need of repairs, the Tools try a new tunnel route to get parts. But on the way, they discover dangerous Drillipedes!

programme.title: Dinotrux
programme.desc: The Trux build a mobile \"part kart\" for repairs out on the road, which comes in handy when Skya gets stranded with a Trux that needs help fast.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. / Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s “fun-crastinating” puts the project in jeopardy. / Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. programme.title: Go, Dog. Go!
programme.desc: It's Ball-entine’s Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. \\ If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Magnum Muslim .357
programme.desc: A Muslim undercover cop, Lieutenant Jamal Razul a.k.a Magnum (ER Ejercito) tracks down a criminal syndicate behind the kidnapping of the Muslim Princess Ameerah (Sam Pinto). Aided by fellow officer Joselito Ibanez (Jerico Ejercito), Razul discovers that there’s more to the kidnapping than mere ransom.

programme.title: Babe, I Love You
programme.desc: Babe, I Love You circles on the story of two individuals who have never thought that love can blossom right at the middle of their two opposite worlds.

programme.title: Akala Mo
programme.desc: Rizette (Judy Ann Santos) is a lady guard and is hopelessly in love with Eric (Dingdong Dantes), one of the tenants in the condominium where she is stationed.

programme.title: Ikaw at Ako
programme.desc: From the challenges faced by a couple in their sunset years to the struggles of those in their mid-years, and the blossoming of a puppy love at a summer camp, this film explores the enduring power of love.

programme.title: Talahib At Rosas 2
programme.desc: Nestor and Juliet used to be friends, but now, they belong to two warring camps. Soon, they find themselves battling a common enemy--a greedy businessman desperate to grab the lands of the poor.

programme.title: Bahay na Pula
programme.desc: Jane (Julia Barretto) and her husband come home to an old ancestral house she inherited from her grandma. As days go by, they realize something evil is living with them in the house.

programme.title: Maid in Malacañang
programme.desc: The Last Days of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos tells the untold story of the last 72 hours of the Marcos dynasty.

programme.title: Tumbok
programme.desc: Cristine Reyes plays the role of Grace, wife to Carlo Aquino's character named, Ronnie, who just moved in an inherited condominium unit from the father of his husband which turn out to be hunted with ghosts. Their mishaps and misfortunes follow as they live there.

programme.title: Room Service
programme.desc: Two lovers thirsty for sex, clash in one story to build an intense passion for love and aspiration.

programme.title: Nilalang
programme.desc: Nilalang tackles the underbelly of corrupt Philippine cops with the Japanese 'Yakuza' and its links to a centuries' old curse that may be responsible for the spate of serial killings happening in Manila.

programme.title: Maid in London
programme.desc: Inspired by true events, a young mother, Margo (Andi Eigenmann) and her best friend, Faye (Alexis Navarro) are forced to cling to the edge of a knife so they could travel in the United Kingdom.

programme.title: The Write Moment
programme.desc: A heartbroken writer tries to get back with an ex through his romantic comedy hugot script but fails and instead finds himself magically living-out the scenes he has written.

programme.title: Para Sa Broken Hearted
programme.desc: Three interweaving stories of broken hearts, that tackle the pain of heartbreak, acceptance, moving on and the courage to learn to love again.

programme.title: Balasubas
programme.desc: Brando (Ace Espinosa) has made up his mind: he's going to rob Teresa (Maricel Morales). But something happens along the way, and he ends up saving her from being kidnapped instead.

programme.title: D' Uragons
programme.desc: Sherlock, a private detective helps Orot, a street-smart fellow who is caught in a dilemma. The two soon discover the syndicate behind the robbery.

programme.title: Para Kang Papa Mo
programme.desc: In the vibrant 1990s Philippines, the infectious trend of village-level dance contests echoes through communities. Young talents Anton, Ric, and Jose are at the heart of it. Yet, envy lurks in the shadows, a malicious force conspiring to dismantle their dreams.

programme.title: Kailangan Ko'y Ikaw
programme.desc: Francine Natra (Regine Velasquez) and Gimo Talumpati (Robin Padilla) crossed paths when Gimo won the \"Date With A Star\" contest thus taking the popular Francine on a special date. But their fairytale love story struggled when the relationship went public.

programme.title: Jowable
programme.desc: Jowable follows the story of Elsa (Kim Molina), no boyfriend since birth as she embarks on finding her one true love. It becomes a question whether an actual future jowa is out there waiting for her.

programme.title: Kaleldo
programme.desc: It follows the lives of Rodolfo \"Mang Rudy\" Manansala, a woodcarver, and his three daughters and their relationships with the people close to them in the span of seven summers.

programme.title: Rosario, 18
programme.desc: Rosario, 18.

programme.title: Siquijor: Mystic Island
programme.desc: Carlo takes the challenge and decides to shoot in Siquijor, an Island in the south well-known of its mysticism. But that's just the beginning of things to come. In the end, the crew learns that truth is indeed stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Full Moon
programme.desc: A young girl (Barbie Forteza) has her first brush with romance. Unluckily for her, her paramour (Derrick Monasterio) bears a dark, monstrous secret that will soon prove to be a challenge for their young love.

programme.title: Habangbuhay
programme.desc: A sheltered girl, who grew up in a very protective family, is asking a boy to fight for their love. If only he was not too consumed by his own battles.

programme.title: Mahal Kita, Final Answer
programme.desc: Nino is a self-starter who now lives a comfortable life. Meanwhile, Joanna is a cheerful person who has made a career out of joining all sorts of contests. When Joanna applied as Nino's assistant, he noticed the luck Joanna brought him so he decided to hire her.

programme.title: The Exorsis
programme.desc: The film follows Gina, who must find an exorcist after her younger sister gets possessed by a dead woman's spirit.

programme.title: Sisterakas
programme.desc: The childhoods of Bernice (Vice Ganda) \u0026 Detty (Ai-Ai Delas Alas) were world's apart, but they did have one thing in common: their father. Headed by the eccentric yet equally brilliant \u0026 talented Roselle (Kris Aquino) the competition gets tougher, and a string of events lead to the two company heads fighting over the once expendable Detty.

programme.title: Baler
programme.desc: Baler is primarily a love story between Feliza, the daughter of a rebel commander (Anne Curtis), and Celso, a half-Spanish soldier (Jericho Rosales), set at the twilight years of the Spanish regime in the Philippines.

programme.title: Luck At First Sight
programme.desc: Joma Labayen (Jericho Rosales) believes that a \"life charm\" would help him win money to pay for his debts. He accidentally meets Diane Dela Cruz (Bela Padilla), who gives him luck only when they are close to each other.

programme.title: No Other Woman
programme.desc: The film revolves on a man's journey on becoming a successful working husband whose perfect marriage becomes complicated when he commits into an adulterous affair that changes his life.

programme.title: Ms. Kristina Moran, Ang Babaeng Palaban
programme.desc: Tina (Rosanna Roces) is a nightclub star performer whose dream is to one day make it big. Her desire for fame and fortune leads her to a string of exciting sexcapades with a variety of men. A hot, riotous movie that will keep you laughing and asking for more.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Sabong
programme.desc: He’s a young man with a rather naive look on life. To transform him into a virile-type of guy, his rich father hires a beautiful and sensuous sabungera to teach him the ways of the world.

programme.title: College Girls
programme.desc: They are four young women brought together by fate. Four young women with different backgrounds and with different stories to tell.

programme.title: ABNKKBSNPLAko? The Movie
programme.desc: The film follows the life of the character named Roberto Ong (Jericho Rosales). It checks the four phases of his life. From childhood memories, his best times in high school, his years in college and until his life as an working adult.

programme.title: Ikaw at Ako
programme.desc: From the challenges faced by a couple in their sunset years to the struggles of those in their mid-years, and the blossoming of a puppy love at a summer camp, this film explores the enduring power of love.

programme.title: Maid in Malacañang
programme.desc: The Last Days of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos tells the untold story of the last 72 hours of the Marcos dynasty.

programme.title: Kiss Mo Ko
programme.desc: Clarisse is neglected by her boyfriend, James. Together with her friends Dindi and Cynthia, they create an imaginary suitor complete with a name- Aaron Nakpil.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Laruang Buhay
programme.desc: Paulo (Raul Zaragoza) is a policeman with a special mission: to find his missing brother. In search for the sibling who rebelled against him, Paulo finds himself in a far-flung town where the mayor is king and the people are timid subjects.

programme.title: Strebel, Gestapo ng Maynila
programme.desc: The era when Western Police District was truly, Manila’s Finest. Major Robert Strebel is a policeman whose strongest trait is his strong sense of duty. A law enforcer who is willing to take the extra length to get his responsibilities done.

programme.title: The Day After Valentine's
programme.desc: A woman should take the responsibility of helping a brokenhearted and self-destructive man to fix his problems.

programme.title: S2pid Luv
programme.desc: George and Bin are orphans with dreams of making it big in the music scene. But when they leave the orphanage to try their luck, they end up as helpers in a junk shop.

programme.title: Working Boys 2: Choose Your Papa
programme.desc: About the bums who need to strategize in life, the roles of the three are sloppy every time they strategize. All three are natural comics so they are very natural in their roles.

programme.title: Won't Last A Day Without You
programme.desc: DJ Heidee (Sarah Geronimo) provides love advice to people who are having problems in their relationships. In the process of getting Melissa and Andrew together, Heidee begin to feel an attraction toward Andrew.

programme.title: Bahay na Pula
programme.desc: Jane (Julia Barretto) and her husband come home to an old ancestral house she inherited from her grandma. As days go by, they realize something evil is living with them in the house.

programme.title: Obsesyon
programme.desc: Screen nymphet Rita Magdalena stars as the object of man’s obsession in this daring movie about a love that knows no bounds and recognizes no rules.
